reason: The analyst ran one specification on an unjustified north-only subsample (N=634) with outcome trimming and only a partial control set. It then read an insignificant coefficient (0.32, SE 0.35) as 'no effect'. My full-sample analysis with all pre-period controls gives +0.69 (SE 0.24, p=0.004), and the analyst's CI easily includes that value, so the 'no effect' conclusion is not supported.
